zh-CN.title: 账户入口更专注
items: 启动页突出账户选择与进入主流程
自动登录紧跟当前账户，设置关系更清晰
其他空间登录收纳为按需展开的次级入口

en.title: A more focused account entry
items: The launcher now focuses on choosing and entering an account
Automatic sign-in is clearly tied to the selected account
Signing in to another space is now a secondary expandable action
